9	/-!
10	# `IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` DISCHARGED — CHART-U(b) at a general test, unconditionally
11	
12	`Picard/Pic0ChartLocusGeneralTest.lean` proves CHART-U(b) over a general test *modulo one
13	hypothesis*: `IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant C`, the transport of `IsSplitWitness` along an
14	**isomorphism** of reading fields.  That was the single input standing between the landed
15	affine openness and `isOpen_chartLocus` over a general test, and its own docstring priced it as
16	"`PicEtAff.map_map` plus `map_id`, not geometry".
17	
18	**This file proves it, and the price was almost that.**  The route is:
19	
20	1. the residue-field extension a morphism of tests induces is a `k`-algebra map
21	   (`Over.testPointFieldMap_comp_algebraMap`) — this was *not* recorded anywhere, and it is what
22	   lets the extension be read as an `AlgHom`/`AlgEquiv` at all.  It is `Spec.preimage` applied to
23	   the naturality square `Over.testPoint_comp_left`, plus the two `Over` triangles;
24	2. an invertible extension is therefore a `k`-algebra **equivalence**
25	   (`Over.testPointFieldAlgEquiv`);
26	3. `IsSplitWitness` is invariant along such an equivalence
27	   (`isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_iff`);
28	4. the naturality square in the `overSpecMap` spelling (`Over.testPoint_comp`) turns (3) into
29	   `IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant`.
30	
31	## What step (3) actually costs, and where the prediction was right
32	
33	The prediction was `map_map` + `map_id`; what it *is* is `PicEtAff.map_map` in the
34	`mapAlg`-into-a-common-target form (`PicEtAff.map_mapAlg_eq_map`) plus
35	`picEtAffineEquiv_naturality`, and the witness clause is carried through untouched.  So the class
36	side is indeed pure functoriality.
37	
38	**What the prediction did not mention is the instance side, and that is the real content.**
39	`IsSplitWitness C μ` existentially quantifies a splitting field `L` *together with seven
40	instances*, four of them about `L` over the reading field: `Algebra K L`, `IsScalarTower k K L`,
41	`Module.Finite K L`, `Algebra.IsSeparable K L`.  Transporting the predicate along `e : K ≃ₐ[k] K'`
42	keeps **the same `L`** but must re-derive all four over `K'`, along `e.symm`.  Two of them are
43	mathlib transports found by name (`Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv`,
44	`Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv`, both stated for exactly this square) and two are
45	`IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq`.  A one-line `rw` this is not; but it is bookkeeping, and no
46	geometry enters — in particular nothing about the curve, the twist, or `H¹` is touched.
47	
48	## Why the forward direction genuinely needs an EQUIVALENCE, not an `AlgHom`
49	
50	`isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap` is stated for `e : K ≃ₐ[k] K'` and the `≃` is load-bearing at a
51	precise point: the transported `Algebra K' L` is `algebraMap K L ∘ e.symm`, which needs `e`
52	*surjective*.  Along a non-invertible `K → K'` there is no `K'`-algebra structure on the old `L`
53	at all, and one would have to base-change `L` — which is the separable-extension route
54	(`exists_witness_of_separable_extension`), a different and strictly harder lemma.  So the `IsIso`
55	hypothesis of `IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` is not packaging; it is what makes the same `L` work.
56	
57	## Main declarations
58	
59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPointFieldMap_comp_algebraMap` — the induced residue-field
60	  extension is a `k`-algebra map.
61	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPointFieldAlgHom` / `Over.testPointFieldAlgEquiv` — that extension
62	  as an `AlgHom`, and as an `AlgEquiv` when it is invertible.
63	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.testPoint_comp` — the `Pic0ChartTestPoint` naturality square as an
64	  equality of morphisms **in the slice**, through `Over.overSpecMap`.
65	* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.map_mapAlg_eq_map` — `map_map` in the form this needs: an explicit
66	  `k`-algebra map into a common target is absorbed by `PicEtAff.map`.
67	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_iff` — `IsSplitWitness` is invariant along a
68	  `k`-algebra equivalence of the reading field.
69	* **`AlgebraicGeometry.isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds`** — the hypothesis of
70	  `Pic0ChartLocusGeneralTest`, discharged.
71	* `AlgebraicGeometry.chartLocus_fromSpecAffine_eq_preimage'`,
72	  `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` — the general-test statements with the
73	  hypothesis removed.  **`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` is CHART-U(b) at a general test with
74	  no residue**, which is what `c9b` consumes as the `V` of `restrictChart`.
75	-/

95	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
96	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]

104	/-! ## The residue-field extension is a `k`-algebra map
105	
106	`testPointFieldMap` is defined as a bare `CommRingCat` morphism (`Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap`),
107	and `Pic0ChartTestPoint` records only its `Algebra` reading via `testPointFieldAlgebra`, which
108	makes `κ(t)` a `κ(f t)`-algebra *without* saying anything about `k`.  For the plus-class
109	transport that is not enough: `PicEtAff.mapAlg` consumes a `k`-**algebra** map, so the fact that
110	the extension is one over `k` has to be proved.  It is exactly the two `Over` triangles read
111	through `Spec.preimage`. -/
112	
113	/-- **The residue-field extension induced by a morphism of tests is a `k`-algebra map.**
114	
115	`testPointFieldMap f t : κ(f t) → κ(t)` commutes with the two `k`-algebra structures of
116	`Pic0ChartTestPoint`, both of which are `Spec.preimage` of a composite down to `Spec k`.  The
117	proof is the naturality square `testPoint_comp_left` composed with `T.hom`, pushed through
118	`Spec.preimage` (a bijection on homs out of an affine, so it turns the commuting square of
119	schemes into the commuting square of rings). -/
120	theorem testPointFieldMap_comp_algebraMap {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
121	    (t : T'.left) :
122	    (testPointFieldMap f t).hom.comp
123	        (algebraMap k (testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t)))
124	      = algebraMap k (testPointField (T := T') t) := by
125	  have hw : (testPoint t).left ≫ T'.hom
126	      = Spec.map (testPointFieldMap f t)
127	          ≫ ((testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t)).left ≫ T.hom) := by
128	    rw [← Category.assoc, ← testPoint_comp_left f t, Category.assoc, Over.w f,
129	      Over.w (testPoint t)]
130	  have hpre := congrArg (fun g => (Spec.preimage g).hom) hw
131	  simp only [Spec.preimage_comp, Spec.preimage_map, CommRingCat.hom_comp] at hpre
132	  exact hpre.symm
133	
134	/-- The residue-field extension at a point, as a `k`-algebra map. -/
135	def testPointFieldAlgHom {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
136	    testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t) →ₐ[k] testPointField (T := T') t :=
137	  { (testPointFieldMap f t).hom with
138	    commutes' := fun r => congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe
139	      (testPointFieldMap_comp_algebraMap f t)) r }
140	
141	/-- **An invertible residue-field extension is a `k`-algebra equivalence.**  This is the shape
142	the `IsSplitWitness` transport consumes, and the `IsIso` hypothesis of
143	`IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` exists precisely to supply it. -/
144	def testPointFieldAlgEquiv {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left)
145	    [IsIso (testPointFieldMap f t)] :
146	    testPointField (T := T) (f.left.base t) ≃ₐ[k] testPointField (T := T') t :=
147	  { (asIso (testPointFieldMap f t)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with
148	    commutes' := (testPointFieldAlgHom f t).commutes }
149	
150	/-- **The naturality square of the bridge, in the slice.**  `Pic0ChartTestPoint.testPoint_comp_left`
151	states it for the underlying scheme morphisms; every class-level transport needs it for the
152	`Over`-morphisms themselves, since `picEtMap` is indexed by those.  Faithfulness of
153	`Over.forget` (`Over.OverMorphism.ext`) is the whole content. -/
154	theorem testPoint_comp {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) (t : T'.left) :
155	    testPoint t ≫ f
156	      = overSpecMap (testPointFieldAlgHom f t) ≫ testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t) :=
157	  Over.OverMorphism.ext (by
158	    rw [Over.comp_left, Over.comp_left, Over.overSpecMap_left]
159	    exact testPoint_comp_left f t)
160	
161	end Over
162	
163	namespace PicEtAff
164	
165	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
166	/-- **`map_map` in the form the transport needs**: an explicit `k`-algebra map `e : K → K'` that
167	is compatible with two towers into a common `L` is absorbed by `PicEtAff.map`.
168	
169	`PicEtAff.map_map` is stated for a chain of `Algebra` instances; here the middle step is an
170	explicit `AlgHom`, so the `Algebra K K'` it needs is manufactured from `e` and the
171	`IsScalarTower K K' L` from `halg`.  This is the class-side half of the whole iso-invariance,
172	and it is pure functoriality — no field, separability or finiteness hypothesis appears. -/
173	theorem map_mapAlg_eq_map {K K' L : Type u} [CommRing K] [Algebra k K]
174	    [CommRing K'] [Algebra k K'] [CommRing L] [Algebra k L]
175	    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K' L] [IsScalarTower k K L] [IsScalarTower k K' L]
176	    (e : K →ₐ[k] K') (halg : ∀ x : K, algebraMap K' L (e x) = algebraMap K L x)
177	    (a : PicEtAff C K) :
178	    PicEtAff.map C L (PicEtAff.mapAlg C e a) = PicEtAff.map C L a :=
179	  letI : Algebra K K' := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
180	  haveI : IsScalarTower k K K' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (e.commutes x).symm
181	  haveI : IsScalarTower K K' L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (halg x).symm
182	  PicEtAff.map_map C K' L a
183	
184	end PicEtAff

186	/-! ## Iso-invariance of the split predicate -/
187	
188	variable (C) in
189	/-- **`IsSplitWitness` transports along a `k`-algebra equivalence of the reading field**
190	(forward direction).
191	
192	The splitting field `L` is **not changed**: along `e : K ≃ₐ[k] K'` the same `L` presents the
193	transported class, via the `K'`-algebra structure `algebraMap K L ∘ e.symm`.  That is where the
194	`≃` is used and cannot be weakened — for a non-invertible `K → K'` no such structure exists and
195	one must base-change `L` instead (`exists_witness_of_separable_extension`, a strictly harder
196	statement).
197	
198	The four instances about `L/K` are re-derived over `K'`: `Algebra K' L` and
199	`IsScalarTower k K' L` by `of_algebraMap_eq`, and `Module.Finite K' L`,
200	`Algebra.IsSeparable K' L` by mathlib's transports along the same commuting square
201	(`Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv`, `Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv`).  The class equation is
202	`picEtAffineEquiv_naturality` plus `PicEtAff.map_mapAlg_eq_map`, and the witness clause `(W, hW,
203	hW1)` is carried through **untouched** — it lives over `L`, which did not move. -/
204	theorem isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap {K K' : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
205	    [Field K'] [Algebra k K'] (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K') (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
206	    (h : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
207	    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e.toAlgHom) nu) := by
208	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, M, hM, W, hW, hW1⟩ := h
209	  letI := hLfield
210	  letI := hkL
211	  letI := hKL
212	  haveI := htow
213	  haveI := hfin
214	  haveI := hsep
215	  -- the SAME `L`, now a `K'`-algebra along `e.symm`
216	  letI hK'L : Algebra K' L := ((algebraMap K L).comp e.symm.toRingHom).toAlgebra
217	  have halg : ∀ x : K, algebraMap K' L (e x) = algebraMap K L x := fun x => by
218	    change (algebraMap K L) (e.symm (e x)) = _
219	    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
220	  haveI htow' : IsScalarTower k K' L := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
221	    change algebraMap k L x = (algebraMap K L) (e.symm (algebraMap k K' x))
222	    rw [show e.symm (algebraMap k K' x) = algebraMap k K x from
223	      (e.symm.commutes x).trans rfl, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K L]
224	  -- the commuting square both mathlib transports are stated against
225	  have hcomp : ((algebraMap K' L).comp (e.toRingEquiv : K →+* K'))
226	      = ((RingEquiv.refl L : L →+* L)).comp (algebraMap K L) :=
227	    RingHom.ext fun x => halg x
228	  haveI hfin' : Module.Finite K' L :=
229	    Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv e.toRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl L) hcomp
230	  haveI hsep' : Algebra.IsSeparable K' L :=
231	    Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv e.toRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl L) hcomp
232	  refine isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness C _ M ?_ W hW hW1
233	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality, PicEtAff.map_mapAlg_eq_map e.toAlgHom halg]
234	  exact hM
235	
236	variable (C) in
237	/-- **Iso-invariance of `IsSplitWitness`, as an `iff`.**  The reverse direction is the forward
238	one at `e.symm`, since `overSpecMap` is functorial and `e.symm ∘ e = id`.  An `iff` is what the
239	locality assembly needs: a one-sided containment would not give openness. -/
240	theorem isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_iff {K K' : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
241	    [Field K'] [Algebra k K'] (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K') (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K)) :
242	    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e.toAlgHom) nu)
243	      ↔ IsSplitWitness C nu := by
244	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap C e nu⟩
245	  have hid : Over.overSpecMap (k := k) e.symm.toAlgHom ≫ Over.overSpecMap e.toAlgHom
246	      = 𝟙 (overSpec k K) := by
247	    rw [← Over.overSpecMap_comp, show e.symm.toAlgHom.comp e.toAlgHom = AlgHom.id k K from
248	      AlgHom.ext fun x => e.symm_apply_apply x, Over.overSpecMap_id]
249	  have hback := isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap C e.symm _ h
250	  rwa [← picEtMap_comp, hid, picEtMap_id] at hback
251	
252	variable (C) in
253	/-- **`IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` — DISCHARGED.**
254	
255	The hypothesis `Picard/Pic0ChartLocusGeneralTest.lean` carries, and the only input standing
256	between the landed affine openness of `chartLocus` and CHART-U(b) at a general test.  With it,
257	`isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` below is unconditional.
258	
259	The assembly is the naturality square in the slice (`Over.testPoint_comp`): reading the class at
260	`κ(t)` after restricting along `f` equals restricting along `Spec` of the residue-field
261	extension, which under the `IsIso` hypothesis is `Spec` of a `k`-algebra **equivalence** — and
262	along one of those `IsSplitWitness` is invariant. -/
263	theorem isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds : IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant C := by
264	  intro T T' f t hiso mu
265	  haveI := hiso
266	  have hfac : picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (picEtMap C f mu)
267	      = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap (Over.testPointFieldAlgHom f t))
268	          (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint (T := T) (f.left.base t)) mu) := by
269	    rw [← picEtMap_comp, ← picEtMap_comp, Over.testPoint_comp f t]
270	  rw [hfac, show Over.testPointFieldAlgHom f t
271	      = (Over.testPointFieldAlgEquiv f t).toAlgHom from AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl]
272	  exact isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_iff C (Over.testPointFieldAlgEquiv f t) _
273	
274	/-! ## CHART-U(b) at a general test, with the hypothesis removed -/
275	
276	variable (C) in
277	/-- `chartLocus_fromSpecAffine_eq_preimage` with its hypothesis discharged. -/
278	theorem chartLocus_fromSpecAffine_eq_preimage' (m : ℕ)
279	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
280	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens) (lam : picEt C T) :
281	    chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)
282	      = (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left.base ⁻¹' chartLocus C m Z lam :=
283	  chartLocus_fromSpecAffine_eq_preimage C (isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds C) m Z T U lam
284	
285	variable (C) in
286	/-- **CHART-U(b) AT A GENERAL TEST, UNCONDITIONALLY.**
287	
288	If `chartLocus` is open over each affine-open test object of `T`, it is open over `T` — with no
289	remaining hypothesis.  This is the `V` that `c9b`'s `restrictChart` needs, and the statement
290	`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s docstring promised. -/
291	theorem isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal' (m : ℕ)
292	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
293	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
294	    (haff : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
295	      IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))) :
296	    IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z lam) :=
297	  isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal C (isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds C) m Z T lam haff
298	
299	end

10	/-!
11	# CHART-U(b) at a general test, from the plus-class identity alone
12	
13	## What this file is
14	
15	The endpoint of the CHART-U(b) chain, assembled.  Reading the chain from the bottom up, the
16	general-test openness `isOpen_chartLocus` rested on:
17	
18	| input | supplied by |
19	|---|---|
20	| iso-invariance of the split predicate | `isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds` (landed, r5) |
21	| `haff` — affine-local openness | `ChartLocusAffineLocal`, **named** at r6 |
22	| `haff` from a per-piece presentation | `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation` (r6) |
23	| `IsChartDatumPresentation` from `hfib` + `hplus` | `isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre` (r6) |
24	| **`hplus` from `hfib`** | **`isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_of_isScalarTower` (r7)** |
25	
26	Only the last row was missing, and it was missing while being cited by name — see
27	`Picard/Pic0ChartPlusFibreTower.lean`'s header for that correction.  With it the chain composes,
28	and this file states the composite so that no consumer has to rebuild it.
29	
30	## What the resulting hypothesis is, precisely
31	
32	`isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` below asks, for each affine open `U` of the test, for a
33	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `Γ(T.left, U)` satisfying `IsChartDatumPlusFibre` — one equation of
34	plus classes per point of `U`.  That hypothesis is:
35	
36	* **witness-free, `H¹`-free and divisor-free.**  No effective divisor, no vanishing cohomology, no
37	  degree.  This matters because those three are exactly what the certificate lane produces, and
38	  their absence is why this leg was always developable ahead of CERT-Σ.
39	* **certificate-free and divRep-free** — and the instrument matters here, because the obvious one
40	  gives the wrong answer.  This module's **import closure is not certificate-free**: it reaches
41	  `DivSchemeCertificate`, `DivSchemeClassify*` and `Pic0AtlasFromDivRep` along
42	  `Pic0ChartLocusFibreField → DivisorFamilyH1Locus → DivRepClassifyZarKit → …`, purely incidentally
43	  (the fibre-field file wants an `H¹` locus, which lives in a module that also serves the
44	  classifier).  So "no certificate module in the imports" is false, and a lane checking
45	  certificate-freedom by grepping imports would wrongly conclude this leg is gated.
46	  What is true is the statement about the **theorems**: walking the transitive *constant*
47	  dependencies of `isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` (7445 constants) and
48	  `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre` (7448) yields **zero** constants whose name contains
49	  `Cert`, `DivFamZar`, `FinCover`, `Classify`, `DivRep` or `divRep`.  Availability is cone-relative
50	  and so is gatedness: measure the declaration's own closure, not the module's imports.
51	* **not vacuous.**  `IsChartDatumPlusFibre` is a genuine equation between plus classes — `rfl` and
52	  `simp` both fail on it at arbitrary `μ`, `D` (measured; recorded on
53	  `isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_self` and re-run for the transport).
54	* **inhabited.**  `exists_splitting_of_picEt` produces, unconditionally on the curve and at any
55	  reading field, a presenting class with exactly this shape — so the hypothesis is satisfiable,
56	  not a reduction to a false premise.  (Both halves of the probe, per the rule this project's
57	  lanes converged on: run the direction matching which arguments the consumer chooses.)
58	
59	## What is still NOT closed, stated so the file is not over-read
60	
61	The hypothesis is a *per-affine-piece existence of a datum with the plus-class property*, and
62	nothing here produces such a datum.  Producing one is a different obligation from anything above:
63	it is the identification of the datum's fibre class with `μ`'s fibre, i.e. the content the c9b row
64	calls the presentation, and for the specific `μ` of the Σ-chart it is where the twist bookkeeping
65	of `w4-datb` §1.2 enters.  So this file closes CHART-U(b) *modulo a producer*, which is strictly
66	what the chain above it needed, and does not claim the producer.
67	
68	In particular this is **not** a claim about `c9b`'s clause (ii).  That clause is the property half

/-- **The plus-class identity of `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`, read at a given extension `L` of the
residue field** rather than at `κ(t)` itself.

Witness-free, `H¹`-free and divisor-free, exactly like `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`: it says the
plus class obtained by restricting `μ` to `κ(t)` and then reading it over `L` is the plus-unit
of `D`'s fibre class at `L`.

This is the form the descent step below consumes, because a split witness for `μ` at `t`
produces its data over an extension it chooses, not over `κ(t)`. -/
def IsChartDatumPlusFibreAt {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π)
    (t : (overSpec k A).left) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    [Algebra (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L]
    [IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t) L] [Algebra A L]
    [IsScalarTower k A L] : Prop :=
  PicEtAff.map C L
      (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
        (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ))
    = PicEtAff.unit C L
        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C A L) D.cechPicClass))
